identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start (0,0). Moved down into cell whose visible onward exits were up/right; track coordinates by successful moves.
At (0,-1); up and right are open, down/left blocked. Previous path: start (0,0) moved down. Choose right to explore the branch.
At (1,-1) after moving right. Horizontal corridor; both sides open, with right leading to an unexplored cell that turns upward. Continue right to explore.
At estimated (2,-1) after successful right move. Open routes are up and left; left is the explored corridor, so take up to explore the new branch. Track path: down, right, right, up.
At (2,0) after path down, right, right, up. Up/left were explored; right is the remaining unexplored branch, with a visible cell beyond that turns down/left. Move right.
At (3,0) after path down, right, right, up, right. Open down and left; left returns to explored corridor. Take down to explore the new branch.
At (3,-1) after path down, right, right, up, right, down. Open up returns to the explored cell; right is unexplored. Continue right.
At (4,-1) after path down, right, right, up, right, down, right. Open up, left, and unexplored right; right leads to a visible dead-end cell, so explore it first.
At (5,-1), a dead end after exploring the far-right branch. Move left back toward the junction and continue systematic exploration of unvisited routes.
At (4,-1) after returning left from the dead end at (5,-1). Right is explored dead end; left leads back through explored corridor. Move up into the unvisited branch.
At (4,0) after moving up from the junction. Up and left are blocked; right and down are open. The right cell is unexplored and may continue upward/left, so explore right first.
At (5,0) after moving right from (4,0). Right and down are blocked; left returns to the explored junction. Explore the upward corridor, which extends three cells and is unvisited.
At (5,1) after moving up from (5,0). Up continues through an unexplored corridor for two cells; down returns to the explored branch. Continue upward exploration.
At (5,2) after continuing upward. Up leads to an unvisited cell with a left branch; down returns along the explored vertical corridor. Explore upward first.
At (5,3) after moving up from (5,2). Up and right are blocked; down returns through the explored corridor. The left branch leads to an unvisited cell, so explore left.
At (4,3) after moving left from (5,3). Open up and right; right returns to the explored branch, so continue upward into the unexplored area.
At (4,4) after moving up. Open right and down; down returns to the explored branch, so explore right into the new cell.
At (5,4) after moving right from (4,4). Open up and left; left returns to the explored cell, while up leads to an unvisited branch. Continue upward.
At (5,5) after moving up. Down returns through the explored corridor; left leads to an unexplored branch extending farther left, so explore left.

At (4,5) after moving left from (5,5). The right route returns to the explored upper branch; the left route is unexplored and continues through a cell with a downward branch. Continue left to explore.
At (3,5) after moving left from (4,5). Up and left are blocked; right returns along the explored upper branch. Take down into the unexplored branch, whose visible cell turns up/left.
At (3,4) after moving down from (3,5). Open up returns to the explored corridor; left is the unexplored branch. Continue left to explore it.
At (2,4) after moving left from (3,4). Right returns to the explored branch; up leads to the unexplored cell shown ahead. Continue systematic exploration upward.
At (2,5) after moving up from (2,4). Down returns to the explored corridor; left is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue left.
At (1,5) after moving left from (2,5). Right returns to the explored corridor; down is the remaining unexplored branch. Explore down.
At (1,4) after moving down from (1,5). Down returns to the explored branch; left leads to the remaining unexplored cell. Explore left.
At (0,4) after moving left from (1,4). Right returns to the explored corridor; up leads to the remaining unexplored branch. Continue upward.
At (0,6) after moving up from (0,5). Up and right are blocked; down returns to the explored corridor, while left leads to the remaining unexplored branch. Explore left.
At (-1,6) after moving left from (0,6). Right returns to the explored corridor; up leads through an unexplored vertical branch, so continue upward.
At (-1,7) after moving up from (-1,6). Up and down are open; the visible cell upward has a right branch, so continue upward to explore the new area.
At (-1,8) after moving up from (-1,7). Up and left are blocked; down returns along the explored vertical branch. Take right into the unexplored branch.
At (0,8) after moving right from (-1,8). Down returns along the explored branch; left is the remaining unexplored route. Explore left.
At (-1,8); left returned from the explored right branch. Both right and down are known routes, so backtrack down to continue searching the remaining maze.
At (-1,7) after backtracking down from the upper branch. Up returns to the explored dead-end area; continue down through the known corridor to search for remaining unexplored routes.

At (-1,6) after backtracking down. Up is the explored upper branch, and right returns through the explored corridor toward the main maze. Move right to continue systematic search for unvisited routes.
At (0,6) after moving right from (-1,6). Both left and down are previously explored; backtrack down toward the main maze and continue searching for an unvisited branch.
Returned to the cell below the start after completing the large right-side exploration. The right branch is exhausted; move up to the start and investigate its remaining left branch.
At the start cell after returning upward from the lower corridor. The down branch is extensively explored; take the remaining left branch to continue searching for the exit.
At (-1,0) after taking the start's left branch. Left and down are blocked; right returns toward the explored start area. Continue upward into the unexplored corridor.
At (-1,1) after moving up from the left branch. Up continues the unexplored vertical corridor; down returns toward the start. Continue upward to search for the exit.
At (-1,2) after continuing up the left-side corridor. Down returns to explored cells; right leads into the remaining unexplored branch. Explore right.
At (0,2) after moving right from the left-side corridor. Down returns to explored cells; left is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue left to search for the exit.
At (-1,2) after returning left from (0,2); both right and down lead to explored cells. Backtrack down through the left corridor to continue the systematic search.
At (-1,1) after descending from the left-side branch. Both vertical routes are known; continue down toward (-1,0) and the start area to search remaining connections systematically.
At (-1,0); up is the explored left-side corridor and right returns to the start. Backtrack right to reassess the central junction and continue searching for the exit.
Back at the start after checking the left-side branch. The central downward branch is the remaining route to recheck for any missed connection or exit; move down and reassess its junctions.
At (0,-1) after moving down from the start. Up returns to the start; the right branch has been explored before but should be rechecked for any missed exit or connection. Move right.
At (1,-1) after moving right from (0,-1). Left returns to the start’s lower branch; up is the remaining unexplored direction from this cell. Move up to continue systematic exploration.
At (1,0) after moving up from the lower branch. Right and down are open; the right cell is the next unexplored-looking branch, while down appears to reconnect with known corridors. Explore right.
At (2,0) after moving right. Left appears to return through explored corridors; take the open down branch to investigate the remaining route.
At the cell reached by moving down from the prior junction. Up returns to the explored corridor; right is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue right and update position if successful.
At (3,-2) after moving right from the lower branch. Open up and left; left returns toward the explored corridor, so take up to investigate the remaining unexplored route.
At (3,-1) after moving up from (3,-2). Open down returns to the explored lower branch; right leads into the remaining unexplored corridor. Continue right.

At (4,-1) after moving right from (3,-1). The corridor continues right to a cell with a downward branch; although this area may overlap earlier exploration, take right to inspect the branch and verify whether it leads toward the exit.
At the current rightmost junction after moving right. Left returns along the known corridor; down leads to a visible cell with up/left exits and is the remaining branch to investigate.
At (5,-2) after moving down from (5,-1). Up returns to the known junction; left is the remaining branch from this cell, so explore left.
At the cell reached by moving left from (5,-2). Right returns to the explored branch; down is the remaining unexplored direction. Continue downward.
At (4,-3) after moving down from (4,-2). Up returns to the explored branch; right is the remaining unexplored route. Continue right.

At (5,-3) after moving right from (4,-3). Open down and left; the downward corridor extends three cells and appears to be the remaining unexplored route, while left is a side branch. Explore downward.

At (5,-4) after moving down from (5,-3). The downward corridor remains open and extends two more cells, while left is a side branch and up returns to the explored route. Continue downward to explore the remaining corridor.
At (5,-4) after moving down. The corridor continues downward through two visible cells; up returns to explored territory and left is a side branch. Continue downward to search for the exit.
At (5,-6) after the previous downward move. Continue down to inspect the final visible corridor cell; if it is a dead end, backtrack and take the left branch from the prior junction.
At (5,-6); downward move was blocked. Up returns along the explored corridor, while left is the only unvisited route from this dead end. Explore left.
At (4,-6) after moving left from the blocked lower dead end. Right returns to the explored corridor; down is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue downward.
At (4,-7) after moving down from (4,-6). Down is blocked; up returns to the explored corridor. Explore the right branch first, then backtrack to investigate left if needed.
At (5,-7) after moving right from (4,-7). This is a dead end with only left open; backtrack left to the junction and investigate the remaining branch.
At (4,-7) after backtracking left from the dead end at (5,-7). Down is blocked and right is explored; left is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue left.
At (3,-7) after moving left from (4,-7). Left and down are blocked; right returns to the explored dead-end branch. Explore the only remaining route by moving up.
At the cell reached by moving up from the left branch. Up and right are blocked; down returns to explored territory, while left is the only unvisited route. Continue left.
At (2,-6) after moving left from the upper branch. Up and left are blocked; right returns to the explored corridor, while down is the remaining unexplored route. Move down.
At (2,-8) after moving down from the lower branch. Up returns to the explored corridor; left is the remaining unexplored route. Continue left to search for the exit.

At the newly reached horizontal corridor after moving left. Both directions are open; the left cell is the continuation of the remaining unexplored branch, while right returns toward the explored route. Continue left.
At the horizontal corridor after moving left. Continue left into the remaining unexplored branch; right returns toward the explored maze.
At (0,-6); left is blocked after the attempted move. Right returns along the explored corridor, so take the only other open route, up, to continue searching the remaining branch.
At (0,-5) after moving up from the blocked corridor. Open down returns to the explored branch; left is the remaining unexplored route. Explore left.
At (-1,-5) after moving left from (0,-5). Open up and right; right returns toward the explored corridor, so continue upward into the unexplored branch.
At (-1,-4) after moving up from (-1,-5). Up continues the unexplored branch; right returns toward the explored corridor. Continue upward.
At (-1,-4); up is blocked. Right leads along a long previously explored corridor, while left enters the remaining unexplored branch. Move left to continue systematic exploration.
At (-2,-4) after moving left from (-1,-4). Left and up are blocked; right returns along the long explored corridor. Take down into the remaining unexplored branch.
At (-2,-5) after moving down from (-2,-4). Right and down are blocked; up returns to the explored junction, while left leads into the remaining unexplored branch. Continue left.
At (-2,-5) after moving left from (-2,-4). Up returns to the explored junction; continue left into the remaining unexplored branch.
At (-3,-5); the attempted left move was blocked, so position is unchanged. Open routes are up, right, and down. Explore down as the least recently investigated branch.
At (-2,-6) after moving down from (-2,-5). Down and left are blocked; up returns to the explored junction. Explore the open right branch.
At (-1,-6) after moving right from (-2,-6). Horizontal corridor: right leads to a visible dead end, while left returns to the explored junction. Explore the right dead end, then backtrack.
At (0,-6) after moving right into a dead end. Only left is open; backtrack left through the horizontal corridor toward the junction and continue exploring remaining branches.
At (-1,-6) after backtracking left from the dead end at (0,-6). The right route is explored; continue left along the corridor to investigate the remaining branch.
At (-2,-6) after moving left from the horizontal dead-end corridor. Left and down are blocked; right returns through explored cells. Take up to investigate the remaining open branch.
At (-2,-5) after moving up. Left is blocked; down returns to the recently explored corridor. Explore the open right branch before backtracking upward.
At (-1,-5) after returning right from (-2,-5). Both left and down-side routes are explored; move up to the junction at (-1,-4), then reassess the remaining corridor.
At (-1,-4) after moving up from (-1,-5). Up and left are blocked; down returns through explored branches. Take the long right corridor back toward the central maze and continue checking for the exit.
At (0,-4) after moving right from (-1,-4). Left and down return to explored branches; continue along the long right corridor to inspect remaining cells for the exit.
At (1,-4) after moving right along the long corridor. Continue right to inspect the remaining corridor cells for an exit or unexplored branch.
At (2,-4) after moving right from (1,-4). The corridor continues right through several cells; nearby branches are already explored, so continue right to inspect the remaining route for the exit.
At (3,-4) after moving right along the corridor. Right remains open and leads through the remaining uninspected cells; continue right to search for the exit.
At (3,-4); right is open through the remaining corridor, while up and down are blocked and left is explored. Continue right to inspect the next cell for the exit.
At the right-end dead end after moving right along the corridor. Only left is open, so backtrack left and continue systematic exploration from the previous junction.
Backtracked from the right dead end to (4,-4). The only useful route is left through the long corridor; continue left toward the next junction and inspect any remaining branch.
At the corridor cell after moving left from the right dead end. Left continues through the long explored corridor and right returns toward the dead end; take up into the remaining branch.
Moved up from the corridor cell at approximately (3,-4), so current estimate is (3,-3). Down returns to the long corridor; left is the remaining branch to explore.
At (2,-3) after moving left from the corridor junction; this is a dead end with only right open. Backtrack right to the prior junction and continue exploring remaining routes.
At the cell reached by moving right from the dead end. Left returns to the dead end; down is the remaining unexplored branch, so continue down.
At the cell reached by moving down from the junction. Down is blocked; up returns to the prior junction. Explore the open right branch first, while left remains an alternate route.
At the horizontal corridor after moving right. The visible cell to the right is a likely dead end and has not been checked from this route; explore right, then backtrack left if blocked.
At the right-end dead end after moving right. Only left is open; backtrack left toward the junction and continue exploring any remaining branches.
At (4,-5) after backtracking left from the right dead end. Right returns to the dead end; left continues through the corridor toward the remaining junctions. Continue left to search for the exit.
At (4,-5) after backtracking from the right dead end. Right is explored; continue left through the corridor toward the remaining junctions and inspect for an unvisited branch or exit.

At the junction after moving left. Up is blocked; right returns through the explored corridor, while left continues along the remaining corridor. Continue left to inspect for an exit or unvisited branch.
At (2,-5) after moving left from the junction. The corridor continues left for two visible cells, while right returns through explored territory. Continue left to inspect the remaining route.
At the current junction after moving left. Up is blocked; the long right corridor is explored, while left continues the remaining route. Continue left to inspect for an exit or unvisited branch.

At (0,-5) after moving left from the prior junction. Up is blocked; right returns through the explored corridor, while left continues the remaining route with a visible downward branch. Continue left to explore.
At (0,-5); left is blocked. Right is the long explored corridor, while down enters the visible branch and is the best remaining route to investigate.
At approximately (0,-6) after the successful move down. Up returns to the explored corridor; left is the remaining open branch and should be investigated for the exit.
At the junction reached after moving left. Left is blocked; the down and right routes appear explored from earlier traversal. Take the upward branch to investigate the remaining route.
At approximately (-1,-5) after moving up. Both vertical routes are known, but the upper cell has a right branch visible; continue upward to inspect that junction for any missed exit.
At the upper junction after moving up. Down returns to the explored vertical corridor; right is the remaining branch to investigate. Move right and track the successful step.
At (0,-4) after moving right from (-1,-4). Left returns to the explored branch; up is the remaining route to inspect for the exit.

At approximately (0,-3) after the successful upward move. Left leads to a visible cell with only a return route, so inspect this likely dead end before backtracking; down returns to the previously explored corridor.
At the dead-end cell reached by moving left from the upper junction. Only right is open, so backtrack right to the junction and continue searching the remaining routes.
Back at the junction after checking the left dead end. The left branch is exhausted; move down along the remaining corridor to continue searching for the exit.
At (0,-4) after descending from the upper dead-end junction. The upward route is checked; left leads back along the corridor and is the best remaining direction to continue systematic exploration.
